basic_profile.bio: Avid film enthusiast and indie game lover, currently residing in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance videographer, with a keen interest in storytelling through digital media. I enjoy exploring new tech, especially apps like FilmicPro, for enhancing mobile filmmaking. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night after wrapping up projects. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time catching up on the latest indie game releases and tuning in to Corpse Husband's streams. Anxiety is something I've battled with over the years, and I find solace in communities that share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a solid understanding of film production, gained through a mix of formal education in media studies and hands-on experience in various film projects. Regularly updates knowledge through online courses and forums. Recently dived into game development as a hobby, focusing on narrative design.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: familiar but not time-sensitive, generally adheres to major rules but may overlook minor posting guidelines if deeply engaged in a discussion.
